method: Read the source of sidecar/fabric_desktop, app/ui, app/src-tauri and .github/workflows
Ran the sidecar test suite (pytest) on Linux, Python 3.13

Drove the engine over its stdin protocol and the fabric-desktop CLI with local data only

No Fabric tenant was used and the Windows app was not run
assessed.test_run: sidecar: 656 passed, 2 skipped (231 s); UI: 23 passed; Rust: not run (build failed on Linux, and CI has no cargo test)

features.name: Desktop shell and local engine
features.description: Tauri 2 exe hosting the plain-JS UI and a Python engine spoken to over JSON lines on stdin/stdout, with no network listener.

evidence.note: sidecar suite passed in this assessment (656 passed, 2 skipped)

evidence.ref: python -m fabric_desktop.server driven over stdin in this assessment
evidence.note: environment, notebooks, cells, jobs, metadata calls answered; an unknown method was refused

evidence.ref: Windows app not run: this assessment ran on Linux; app/src-tauri cargo test could not build (gdk-3.0 missing)

limitations: All RPC calls are serialized behind one mutex (main.rs rpc); calls outside the watchdog's quick list have no time limit, so a long Fabric call blocks every page
Windows only for the desktop app; the engine and agent also run on Linux
features.next_action: Run the Windows smoke test of ten core flows on the maintainer's tenant (PB-002).
